$comment: Isolinear project settings. The first SessionStart hook is a fail-open branch-agnostic git drift-check (plus the continuity guard) so every session opens knowing whether the checkout is clean and current with its upstream. The second is the telemetry add-on (token/spend). The permissions allowlist pre-approves read-only inspection so routine git/ls/test reads aren't prompted.

hooks.command: git fetch origin --quiet 2>/dev/null; st=$(git status --porcelain 2>/dev/null); behind=$(git rev-list --count HEAD..@{u} 2>/dev/null || echo 0); if [ -z "$st" ] && [ "$behind" = "0" ]; then echo 'repo: clean, up to date with upstream'; else echo "repo DRIFT: behind=$behind"; [ -n "$st" ] && echo "$st"; fi; [ -f scripts/continuity_budget.py ] && python3 scripts/continuity_budget.py --check 2>/dev/null; true

SessionStart.$comment: telemetry add-on (claude/token-tracking.md, claude/spend-tracking.md) — initializes the token baseline and records the session-start marker. Additive: the drift-check entry above is untouched. Fail-open.
